notes: Category H contains NO calculator tools (no fees, rates, or numeric pricing). All numeric logic is trivial deterministic text/measurement math, documented below and in FEAS-H.md; none of it requires a versioned formula record.

(1) Pin ratio reduction (tool-361 Pinterest Pin Ratio Checker): ratio = W:H reduced by GCD(W,H); format matched against {2:3 standard, 1:1 square, 9:16 idea, 1:2.1 long-crop}. Elementary math - no source needed.

(2) X weighted character counting (tools 370-374, 379-380, 383): budget = 280; cost(c) = 1 per BMP char, 2 per emoji/CJK char, 23 per URL, 0 per attached media. Corroborated by X developer docs via Circleboom (2026-09) and sergebulaev x-skills (2026-09). Rule record: data/platform-rules/x.json -> x-weighted-counting.

(3) A/B title scoring rubric (tool-366) and hook analysis rubric (tool-376): heuristic weighted rubrics, weights fixed at implementation time and documented in FEAS-H.md. These are JUDGMENT rubrics, not platform facts - they must be labeled 'heuristic estimate' in UI and are intentionally NOT registered as verified formulas.
